Requests to undefined routes fall through with no response, which can expose routing details or cause client hangs.

The endpoints have no protection against abuse or brute-force enumeration.

| # | Category | Before | After |
|---|----------|--------|-------|
| 1 | **Input validation** | No query param validation | Allowlist of permitted params; type + regex checks |
| 2 | **Error handling** | No global error handler | Global `(err, req, res, next)` middleware; no stack trace leakage |
